title: Mom's Misinformation Machine - research starter
scope: Twelve original draft subjects and precisely worded claims. Not a comprehensive conspiracy database. No scored questions approved.
classification_policy: Grade exact statements, never subjects. Documented events may have separate unsupported theories attached. Unsupported, contradicted, disputed, and unresolved remain distinct evidence statuses.
iceberg_policy: Tiers 1-8 are an original proposed familiarity ladder; these twelve examples occupy tiers 1-5 only. No objective or inherited community ranking is asserted.
rarity_policy: No real player rarity data exists in this starter. Use versioned answer statistics after calibration; never equate editorial iceberg tier, death toll, or unsupportedness with rarity.
